A chibi plushie depicting a young-adult-appearing man with light skin tone and curly, light-colored fabric hair emerges from beneath a wide-brimmed fabric hat. The hat crown is striped with orange and white soft fabric, and the brim is red fabric outlined in yellow fabric. The plushie wears a fabric tunic vertically divided, the left side (viewer's left) blue with a yellow fabric sleeve and the right side red with a blue fabric sleeve. A yellow and blue fabric belt encircles the plushie's waist. Its legs are clad in blue fabric tights and its shoes are red fabric.

The plushie holds a thin, golden-yellow soft fabric object, possibly a wand or a rod, in its raised right plushie hand. Its left plushie hand rests on a light brown soft fabric wooden table standing on four legs. On the table are various soft fabric objects: a golden cup, a red cup, several golden coins or discs, two knives (one with a black fabric handle and one with a white fabric handle), and a pouch or bag. The chibi plushie is centered and uncropped, sitting on a plain white background with even, soft lighting, as if for a product listing.
